script:
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace/sub" --expect 200 --check . contains qa-f16-sub --save F16.dir-index/sub
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace/sub/" --expect 200 --check . contains qa-f16-sub
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace/empty-dir" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'No index.html in directory' --save F16.dir-index/no-index
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$BARE/workspace" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'No index.html in directory'
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$BARE/workspace/readme.txt" --expect 200 --check . contains qa-f16-bare
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace/qa-f16-missing.txt" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'File not found' --save F16.dir-index/missing
